name: Porno S Dushoj
source:
Our protagonist, named Artem, finds himself transported in an unusual way to... where else but the pioneer camp Sovyonok! Exciting adventures, romance, available women, explicit content, memes, the absurd script written by the author, and strong rivals await him. Dangerous mutants and bandits will not stop our hero on his path to solving the mystery of the camp! Join Artem on his incredible adventures!

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2163672931]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们的主人公阿尔乔姆以一种意想不到的方式穿越到了……还能是哪儿呢，当然是“小猫头鹰”少先队夏令营！刺激的冒险、浪漫的恋情、可攻略的美女、火辣的成人内容、趣味梗、作者放飞自我的荒诞剧本，以及强劲的对手都在等待着他。无论是危险的变异怪物还是凶悍的强盗，都无法阻挡我们的英雄解开夏令营谜团的脚步！快来加入阿尔乔姆不可思议的大冒险吧！
